summary: Round 3 testing: Budget Alerts, Recurring Autopilot (incl. cron auth), Goal Funding Plan, Year Compare + current-year regression. Backend: 38/38 pytest tests pass (10 new added). Alerts endpoint returns categories >=80% with correct level/pct/spent/budget. Autopilot/run idempotent (first run 0 inserts for demo since current month already seeded; second run also 0). Cron endpoint correctly returns 401 for no token and bad token, 200 {queued:true} for correct WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET. Settings autopilot toggle PUT persists. /api/goals/plan returns avg_monthly_income/total_monthly/pct_income/plan with per-goal remaining/months_left/monthly. /api/compare returns 12 rows, current and previous totals; previous year (2025) is seeded (income>0, expense>0). Regression: dashboard total_income = ~$58K (not doubled to ~$116K); paycheck entries all start with current year (2026); expense breakdown current-year only. Frontend: demo login OK. Dashboard budget-alerts card shows 6 categories (Shopping 103%, Rent 101%, etc.) with spent/budget amounts and progress bars. nav-funding renders fund-income $5,800.00, fund-needed $637.50 (11% of income), fund-leftover $5,162.50; allocation bar and per-goal cards (testid funding-<id>) with 'Set aside monthly' present. nav-compare renders compare-income ($58K vs $58.8K), compare-expenses, compare-net, recharts grouped bar chart, and 12-row month-by-month table with change %. Setup page shows autopilot-toggle and autopilot-run-btn (via Switch); clicking Run now triggers toast 'You're already caught up for this month' (idempotent correct).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now 1229 lines — well past the 700-line threshold. Strongly recommend splitting into routers/services modules (alerts, autopilot, goals, compare, rates, bulk, paycheck, breakdown).
generate_recurring picks source_months[0] i.e. most recent prior month; if that month happened to be partial, newly-generated month will inherit the partial set. Minor product edge-case, not a bug.
cron_autopilot uses hmac.compare_digest on raw bearer — good. However, if WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET is empty, request is 401 (early return). Fine.
goals/plan avg_income divides YTD income by month_now — safe for Jan onward but produces inflated averages in early days of a month if income is lumpy. Document or switch to trailing-12 average.
/api/compare iterates all txns twice via dict build — O(N) acceptable; for larger users consider aggregation pipeline.
seed_data_creation: No persistent seed added. TestAutopilot briefly toggles settings.autopilot True then restores to False.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Round 3 features all green. Goal cards on /funding use data-testid 'funding-<id>' (not 'goal-card-*'). Autopilot run toast shows 'You're already caught up for this month' when inserted=0. Backend tests expanded to 38 total; see TestAlerts, TestAutopilot (incl. cron 401/401/2xx), TestGoalsPlan, TestCompare, TestCurrentYearRegression.
